cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Mrs. Iselin O'Donnell, New York, NY, 1947; Estate of Iselin O'Donnell, 1972; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 3454, lot no. 142, 13 December 1972 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946." Reproduced and titled *Waterfall Number 2, Iao Valley, Maui*, in *New York Times* (February 1940). See cat. nos. 1914–16, 1923. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A far-off white waterfall cuts through a deep, V-shaped valley. Tall green mountains stand on either side of the large valley, and misty white clouds fill the sky above.
title: Waterfall, No. 2, ʻĪao Valley
